import pytest

from sqlparse.engine.statement_splitter import StatementSplitter

def run(stream):
    """Run the splitter and return list of statements."""
    return list(StatementSplitter().process(stream))


def token(ttype, value):
    return sql.Token(ttype, value)


def stream_from(*tokens):
    return [(t.ttype, t.value) for t in tokens]


def values_flat(stmt):
    return [t.value for t in stmt.flatten() if not t.is_whitespace]


def all_values(stream_result):
    return [values_flat(s) for s in stream_result]

        assert sp._unconfirmed_start is None
        assert sp._is_create is False
        assert sp._seen_begin is False
        assert sp.consume_ws is False
        assert sp.tokens == []
        assert sp.level == 0

        sp = StatementSplitter()
        sp._block_stack.append('BEGIN')
